label: AbraFlexi Benchmark
info:
Receives AbraFlexi Benchmark results via webhook, aggregates per-cycle timing data into avg/max/spike stats, then uses the evidence-type record nodes to fetch the full record that was just benchmarked.

Source: https://github.com/VitexSoftware/AbraFlexi-Tools

Run:
  make benchmark  (in AbraFlexi-Tools directory)

Setup:
  1. Set the four tab env vars (gear icon on the tab).
  2. Configure the 'AbraFlexi Server' config node (double-click any evidence node).
  3. Register the webhook in AbraFlexi pointing to /abraflexi-benchmark.

name: Aggregate Metrics + Dispatch
